subject: Temporary escrow/invoice path for onboarding — payment flexibility request
messages:
From: Carla Ruiz <carla@orionai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Temporary payment path for pilot onboarding?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Orion team is excited to start the three-week pilot. Two quick asks from our finance side before we kick off:

1) Our standard procurement requires a PO to release services invoiced to our accounts payable. For a short pilot we usually do invoice-only (Net-30) or an escrow-style holdback managed by payments.
2) Can Redwood support an invoice-only trial (no PO) or set up a temporary escrow arrangement for the pilot amount?

I attached our completed onboarding form and SOC2 snapshot to speed the intake. If you need anything else (W-9, bank info), Miguel and I can provide it.

Goal: get access and start by next Monday. What information do you need from us to make a short-term exception?

Thanks,
Carla
Carla Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, Orion AI
carla@orionai.com

Attachments: Orion_onboarding_form.pdf, SOC2_snapshot_2027.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Carla Ruiz <carla@orionai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Temporary payment path for pilot onboarding?

Hi Carla — thanks for the quick follow-up and for sending the form. Glad the demo landed well.

I looped in Laura (procurement) and Soojin (finance) to scope safe options. High level — Redwood policy prefers POs for ongoing engagements, but we do have short-term paths for low-risk pilots. Two pragmatic options we can pursue:

- Option A: Invoice-only (Net-30) for pilot, capped at $5,000 — requires completed onboarding form + SOC2 + vendor tax form (W-9). Procurement pre-approval needed.
- Option B: Temporary escrow/holdback for the full pilot cap (we can hold funds via our payments desk) up to $10,000 while you consume capacity. Legal sign-off required on a short escrow addendum.

If Orion prefers Option B we can send a one-page temporary escrow agreement for signature and coordinate DocuSign. If Option A fits, please confirm you can provide W-9 and bank remit info and we’ll route for procurement approval (approximately 2 business days).

What’s your preferred path? If you want Option B, can you confirm the pilot cap you expect?

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0118

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Carla Ruiz <carla@orionai.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel.s@orionai.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jan 2028 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Temporary payment path for pilot onboarding?

Hi all — procurement here. Short summary and required next steps so we can move fast while staying within policy guardrails.

Context: Redwood requires POs for standard vendor setup. For pilots we will consider temporary non-PO paths under controlled conditions. Based on the materials provided (onboarding form + SOC2 snapshot), Orion looks low risk.

Approved temporary options (pick one):

A) Invoice-only (Net-30), one-off pilot cap up to $5,000
   - Requirements: signed onboarding form, SOC2 snapshot, vendor W-9, and invoice sent to finance@redwood.com
   - Procurement approval window: 1-2 business days once docs are received.

B) Temporary escrow (payments-managed) up to $10,000
   - Requirements: signed temporary escrow addendum (attached draft-temp-escrow-agreement.pdf), vendor banking info, W-9.
   - This route allows consumption up to the agreed cap before issuing a PO; payments will maintain the hold and release per the addendum. Legal needs to countersign — timeline ~3 business days if counterparty signs quickly.

We will not approve invoice-only above $5k without a PO. If Orion prefers escrow, we will initiate DocuSign routing on our side once you confirm and return the signed addendum.

Action items for Orion:
- Confirm preferred option (A or B) and pilot cap (if B).
- Return signed onboarding form and W-9.
- If B chosen, sign the attached escrow addendum and provide bank details.

Happy to expedite. Jonas, please keep me in the loop on expected start date so procurement can prioritize the approval.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: draft-temp-escrow-agreement.pdf

From: Carla Ruiz <carla@orionai.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.s@orionai.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jan 2028 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Temporary payment path for pilot onboarding?

Hi Laura / Jonas — thanks for the clear options. We reviewed internally and would like to proceed with Option B (temporary escrow) at a $10,000 cap so the pilot can run without interruptions.

We signed the onboarding form and attached it here (signed-onboarding-form.pdf). Miguel will pull together the W-9 and bank remit info and send in the next hour. Please route the draft escrow agreement to our legal for signature — DocuSign is fine.

Timeline request: can payments + legal complete routing within 3 business days? We want to start provisioning by Monday if possible.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Carla Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, Orion AI
carla@orionai.com

Attachments: signed-onboarding-form.pdf
